Frisbee Fun for Dog and Owner Do you feel like trying something new with your four-legged friend? "Disc Dogging", that is Frisbee sport with dogs, is becoming more and more popular. Playing with the disc promotes your pet's physical and mental fitness and strengthens the bond between you. With our throwing disc you are well equipped for the new sportive challenge: The Dog Disc is made of flexible, soft and durable plastic and has optimal flight characteristics. In addition, it is bite-resistant and splinter-free. The toy was developed together with the successful disc dogging champion Karin Actun.
